display.purpose: Shop names on Diary and Entry.

label.purpose: Stamps, folios, tabs, filters, plate numbers.

shadows.name: mounted-print
shadows.purpose: Depth under a paper mat only.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One authored entrance for the newest print.

components.name: Ink link
components.description: Square action drawn as a brass rule under the label.
components.css: .ds-ink-link { background: transparent; color: #ded8cc; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #9a8768; padding: 6px 0; font: 400 .78rem/1.5 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .16em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ink-link:hover { color: #9a8768; } .ds-ink-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9a8768; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter stamp
components.description: Dish filter with a tabular count; selected gets a brass rule.
components.css: .ds-filter { background: transparent; color: #9a968b; border: 1px solid #2a2d30; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 400 .76rem 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .14em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #ded8cc; border-color: #9a8768; } .ds-filter b { color: #9a8768; font-weight: 400; margin-left: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Date stamp
components.description: Double-ruled ink date on an entry.
components.css: .ds-date-stamp { display: inline-block; border: 2px double #9a8768; color: #9a8768; font: 400 .7rem 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .2em; padding: 6px 12px; transform: rotate(-1deg); }

components.name: Dish stamp
components.description: Oxblood for Zhujiaofan, sage for Shaorou.
components.css: .ds-dish-stamp { display: inline-block; border: 2px solid #7a4a46; color: #d9a49b; font: 400 .7rem 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .18em; padding: 5px 11px; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-dish-stamp--crisp { border-color: #6f7a5c; color: #bcc9a7; transform: rotate(2deg); }

components.name: Photo mat
components.description: Paper mount for every photograph, with an overlapping plate label.
components.css: .ds-mat { position: relative; display: block; background: #d8d2c4; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 8px 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-mat img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 300px; object-fit: cover; background: #292e2a; } .ds-plate-label { position: absolute; top: -9px; left: -9px; background: #111316; border: 1px solid #9a8768; color: #9a8768; font: 400 .62rem 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .16em; padding: 5px 9px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Single-rule search on the map list.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #ded8cc; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2d30; padding: 9px 0; font: 400 .8rem/1.5 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; caret-color: #9a8768; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #9a968b; } .ds-search:focus { border-bottom-color: #9a8768; outline: none; }

components.name: Print thumbnail
components.description: Numbered print in the ledger strip; brass ring marks the current one.
components.css: .ds-print { flex: 0 0 168px; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: #9a968b; } .ds-print-mat { display: block; background: #d8d2c4; padding: 6px; } .ds-print-mat img { width: 100%; height: 86px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-print.is-current .ds-print-mat { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #9a8768; } .ds-print-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font: 400 .62rem 'Courier Prime', monospace; padding-top: 7px; } .ds-print-meta b { color: #9a8768; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: A private record of real visits, kept like a bound book and shown as tipped-in prints. The visitor arrives on a dark page and meets one large photograph on a warm paper mat, an ink date stamp, a dish stamp, and the owner's line beside it. Colour belongs to the food; the UI holds one brass accent and two dish stamps. There are no cards, gradients, glow, or glass.
keyCharacteristics: Ground #111316, paper mat #d8d2c4, brass #9a8768, oxblood and sage dish stamps.
Spectral for display and reading, Courier Prime for stamps, folios and labels.
One soft offset shadow under a mounted print; no shadows on controls.

rules.name: The Mat Rule
rules.body: Every photograph sits on paper. No photo is placed directly on the dark ground.

rules.name: The Two-Stamp Rule
rules.body: Oxblood and sage belong to dishes only. Brass belongs to actions only. They never swap jobs.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is for measurement and labels only; running text is always Spectral.

dos: Do mount every photograph on the paper mat with a plate number.
Do keep brass under 10% of any screen; its rarity is the point.
Do keep all controls at least 44px with a 2px brass focus ring.
Do let the print strip carry scale from one entry to a hundred.
donts: Don't use bright orange, neon accents, gradients, glass, or glow.
Don't put dish stamps on navigation or UI chrome.
Don't add cards, nested panels, or decorative section numbers.
Don't invent shops, photographs, ratings, or prices.
